claim_text: On 8 July 2026 Trump boarded Air Force One in view of television cameras as he left the Nato summit in Turkey, but was reportedly spirited away via a catering truck to a C-32A that flew him to RAF Mildenhall, leaving unwitting decoys aboard the larger aircraft.
quote: the president had reportedly already been secretly spirited away via a catering truck to a C-32A, a military version of the Boeing 757, which flew the president to RAF Mildenhall in the UK.
confidence_justification: The BBC itself hedges with "reportedly"; the Secret Service has not commented and the White House had neither confirmed nor denied at the time of publication.
